**Finding submitted: deviation (MINCOMMIT), confidence 0.62.**

What I found:
- **No express "minimum purchase" or "take or pay" clause** exists, but the economics operate as one: Exhibit B fixes a flat annual **MarketSite.net Access Fee** (Year 1; Years 2–5 and beyond, p0153) payable "on each annual anniversary" (p0168) across a **five-year initial term** (p0096) exitable only for material breach or insolvency (p0097) — a multi-year commitment with no reduction or termination right, i.e. our walk-away position.
- Secondary hit: the Application Management revenue share is measured against a **deemed "minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer"** (p0158) rather than actual usage.
- Direction checked: maintenance fees are already conditional on Corio electing to continue (4.2), Exhibit D cooperation is expressly **non-binding** (p0198), and Commerce One's revenue-share commitment to us (p0156) was left untouched.

Redline (validated, ok:true) — fallback level, minimal edits:
1. p0168 — adds a right for Corio to discontinue MarketSite.net access on **30 days' notice**, stopping further annual fees, with a **pro-rata true-up "without penalty, shortfall or termination charge."**
2. p0158 — replaces the deemed 40-user minimum with the **actual number** of Authorized Software Users.
